summary: # Star Schema Design for Power BI ## Overview Star schema is the optimal design pattern for Power BI semantic models. It organizes data into: - **Dimension tables**: Enable filtering and grouping (the "one" side) - **Fact tables**: Enable summarization (the "many" side) ## Table Classification ### Dimension Tables - Contain descriptive attributes for filtering/slicing - Have unique key columns (one row per entity) - Examples: Customer, Product, Date, Geography, Employee
